name: bq-personal-import-relief
description: Analyse 2026 BES import relief for moving households, inherited personal goods, students, low-value post, private gifts and travellers' baggage. Use to select the relevant permission, person, goods, value, age, quantity and time conditions before computing import taxes. Separates duty, ABB and excise, normal residence from income-tax residence, and oral declarations from exemptions. Includes primary legislation, authority guidance and fictional boundary cases. This source-cited draft holds actual valuation, classifications, disputed eligibility, forms and other relief regimes. Load with the universal workflow base and BES companions; professional review remains required before reliance.
